messages:
laura_marketing: Quick sync — finalizing X + LinkedIn copy experiments for the webinar bump and benchmark narrative. Need final creative + UTM rules + SDR routing by EOD so jenna can queue schedules tomorrow. :rocket:

miguel_content: Got it. Are we doing 2 copy variants per platform (short vs. narrative)? Also need hero image + 15s clip if possible.

sam_growth: Recommend 2 variants: V1 focuses on benchmark results (cost/latency wins), V2 is a story-led hook (customer before/after). We should tag leads routed from V1 as `bench_interest` and V2 as `product_story`.

jenna_social: Timeline check — if I get assets by 5pm PT I can schedule X and LI staggered across timezones for Wed/Thu. Do we want simultaneous posting or stagger to maximize reach?

laura_marketing: Stagger by timezone, please. Priority: X high-velocity + LI long-form. Also want an initial 1-hr monitoring window after each post for quick engagement replies. @sam_growth can you own the first-hour triage? :eyes:

sam_growth: I can. Will set up a short playbook for replies + follow-up DM templates for top engaged accounts.

miguel_content: Draft copy below — please pick A/B and minor edits welcome.

```
X Variant A (short): Stop paying for latency. See how we cut inference cost 2x while improving tail latency. Watch our webinar. --> [link]?utm_source=x&utm_campaign=webinar_benchA
X Variant B (story): We built a product feature that used to cost $X/token. After switching serving strategy, latency dropped and costs followed. Demo + deep dive in our free webinar. --> [link]?utm_source=x&utm_campaign=webinar_storyB
LinkedIn Variant A (long): Quick benchmark breakdown + slide CTA, tags: #MLOps #Inference
LinkedIn Variant B (narrative): 3-step story (problem, approach, outcome) + webinar sign-up link, tags: #AI #Performance
```

laura_marketing: Love these. Minor ask: for X copy include a soft CTA 'save your spot' rather than 'watch'. Also add UTM param `traffic_bucket` with values `benchA`/`storyB` so we can split leads in the CRM.

sam_growth: Noted. Routing rules: leads with `traffic_bucket=benchA` -> SDR queue `bench-sdr`; `traffic_bucket=storyB` -> `growth-sdr`. Also send webhook to CRM with `initial_channel` and `engagement_score` tags.

olivia_ops: Scheduler is open for those windows. Jenna — I'll give you edit rights on the scheduler. Also creating a short webhook consumer in Staging to capture the `traffic_bucket` param, will push to prod once validated.

scheduler_bot: Drafts created: X_VariantA_1769, X_VariantB_1769, LI_VariantA_1769. Link: https://scheduler.internal/drafts/1769 (internal).

jenna_social: Uploaded hero image + 15s clip to the drive folder: https://drive.redwood.ai/marketing/webinar_assets/1769 (preview ready). Miguel — check the clip aspect ratios for X stories vs LI feed.

miguel_content: Checked. Clip is vertical 9:16 and 1:1 for feed exported. Hero image is 1200x627 and a square crop ready. Approved for scheduling.

laura_marketing: Perfect. One more: engagement follow-up sequence — within 24h, send top engagers (likes/comments) a short DM with a personalized note + sign-up nudge. Sam, add templates to the playbook.

sam_growth: Will add DM templates and tracking sheet. Also recommend an A/B test on CTA wording in the DM: `save your spot` vs `join the demo`.

jenna_social: Scheduling tomorrow AM. I'll tag posts with `traffic_bucket` UTMs and set TTL for pinned post on X to 48h.

laura_marketing: Final checklist summary: 1) Assets in drive (done), 2) Copy variants updated with `traffic_bucket` UTMs (miguel + laura), 3) Scheduler drafts queued (scheduler_bot), 4) Routing rules to CRM implemented (sam + olivia), 5) Monitoring + playbook (sam). If no objections I'll close this thread at 5pm PT. :thumbsup:

miguel_content: One tiny ask — can legal run a quick sweep on the benchmark claim phrasing? I'll ping legal now.

laura_marketing: Go ahead. If legal flags anything, we swap to `performance improvements` language.

sam_growth: I'll prepare the `bench-sdr` vs `growth-sdr` welcome scripts and link to the tracking sheet in the playbook.

olivia_ops: Webhook consumer staged, will deploy to prod after one quick end-to-end test when posts go live.

jenna_social: Noted. I'll post the exact scheduled times in #calendar once queued.

laura_marketing: Thanks team — ticking this off. See you tomorrow for the post-launch sync.
